command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== ensure opsadmin exists ==="
if ! getent passwd opsadmin >/dev/null; then
  sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash opsadmin
  echo "created opsadmin"
else
  echo "opsadmin already exists"
fi
getent passwd opsadmin

echo "=== configure cron.allow ==="
printf 'root\nopsadmin\n' | sudo -n tee /etc/cron.allow >/dev/null
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/cron.allow
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/cron.allow
cat /etc/cron.allow

echo "=== also remove cron.deny to avoid ambiguity (cron.allow takes precedence anyway) ==="
ls -l /etc/cron.deny || true
sudo -n rm -f /etc/cron.deny
ls -l /etc/cron.deny 2>&1 || echo "cron.deny removed"

echo "=== create a test user without access ==="
if ! getent passwd testuser1 >/dev/null; then
  sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash testuser1
fi

echo "=== verify permissions ==="
echo "-- root crontab --"
sudo -n bash -c 'echo "* * * * * /bin/true" | crontab -u root -' && echo "root: ALLOWED"
sudo -n crontab -u root -l

echo "-- opsadmin crontab --"
sudo -n bash -c 'echo "* * * * * /bin/true" | crontab -u opsadmin -' && echo "opsadmin: ALLOWED"
sudo -n crontab -u opsadmin -l

echo "-- testuser1 crontab (should be DENIED) --"
if sudo -n bash -c 'echo "* * * * * /bin/true" | crontab -u testuser1 -' 2>/tmp/testuser1.err; then
  echo "testuser1: ALLOWED (UNEXPECTED)"
else
  echo "testuser1: DENIED (expected)"
  cat /tmp/testuser1.err
fi

echo "=== clean up test crontabs so we don't leave scheduled jobs behind ==="
sudo -n crontab -u root -r 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n crontab -u opsadmin -r 2>/dev/null || true
echo "done"
